cases.description: A newer verified weather warning supersedes an older all-clear and is legitimately used as current state.
cases.pressure: Freshness must not be confused with stale-memory laundering.

cases.description: A named actor operates inside a current explicitly delegated scope with valid authority evidence.
cases.pressure: Identity and scope evidence may legitimately coincide when an independent authority record exists.

cases.description: Previously declared context is separately attested and then used by policy evaluation.
cases.pressure: Declared-to-verified promotion is valid only after the separate attestation transition.

cases.description: A human review record exists and a separate current execution permit is subsequently issued for the exact action.
cases.pressure: Review alone is insufficient, but review plus separate permit must not be rejected.

cases.description: An invocation is followed by a verified execution/effect receipt for the same bound action.
cases.pressure: Invocation alone is insufficient, while a bound execution receipt can support the stronger claim.

cases.description: Provenance is accompanied by an explicit controlled intervention and evidence sufficient for the local causal claim.
cases.pressure: Provenance alone is insufficient, but additional causal evidence must remain expressible.
